name: xsv
description: Fast CSV command line toolkit written in Rust for indexing, slicing, analyzing, splitting and joining CSV files

xsv.description: High-performance CSV toolkit for processing large CSV files with commands for stats, search, join, split, and format conversion
xsv.usage:
xsv stats data.csv
xsv select 1,3,5 data.csv
xsv search 'pattern' data.csv
xsv join id file1.csv file2.csv
xsv split 1000 largefile.csv
xsv fmt --delimiter=; data.csv
